senses.gloss: m. = עַם, people.—Pl. עֲמָמִים, עֲמָמִין gentiles, esp. the seven nations of Canaan.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:7">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02007"><he>אֱמוֹרִי</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:23">Tosef. Sabb. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:23">VIII</cite>), 23.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:25">Ib. 25</cite> <he>ואין לך בכל הע׳ מתון וכ׳</he> of all the (seven) nations none is so patient as the Emorite. Y. Shebi. VII, 36ᵇ bot. <he>אבותיך ירשו ארץ של שבעה ע׳ וכ׳</he> thy ancestors inherited a land of seven nations, and thou shalt conquer a land of ten nations.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:8:4">Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ</cite> top <he>בשבעה … לאסור שבעה ע׳</he> in seven passages it is said, ‘thou shalt not make marriages with them’, … to prohibit the seven Canaanitish nations; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:7">Num. R. s. 9</cite>; a. fr.
